# Upstream attribution

This fixture contains selected files from **Reliability is Blind - Collective
Incentives for Decentralized Computing Marketplaces without Individual
Behavior Information** by Henry Mont, Matthieu Bettinger, Sonia Ben Mokhtar,
and Anthony Simonet-Boulogne.

- Source: <https://github.com/RedChainLab/Reliability-Is-Blind-Collective-Incentives>
- Pinned revision: `98adffaa7931c74cdd749cde230b7e87c9d45d86`
- Paper: <https://doi.org/10.1109/EDCC-C66476.2025.00048>
- Archive: <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18179569>
- License: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); the complete upstream license is included in [LICENSE](LICENSE).

Only `coll_SR.py`, `marketplace.py`, and `run_marketplace.py`, the files used by
the parity test, are reproduced. CRLF line endings were normalized to LF and a
terminal newline was added; the source code was otherwise unchanged. This
fixture is not endorsed by the original authors.
